title: JANUS Universal Beetle — four mirrors, Demiurge Director, durable cross-repository discovery memory

director.role: choose bounded discovery attention and temporary questions

beetle.role: discover, graze, deduplicate source identities, project mirror contexts, route bounded inbox snapshots

target_memory_receiver.role: target repository validates only its addressed batch and persists it into an isolated beetle-memory branch

meaning.REVERSE: inverse, reconstruction, source recovery and identifiability search
meaning.COUNTEREVIDENCE: failure, null, counterexample, limitation, bias and confound search
meaning.CONTROL: replication, benchmark, baseline, calibration, ablation and independent-validation search

source_identity_and_context_model.source_deduplication: one source identity remains one source identity
source_identity_and_context_model.context_projection: the same source may be projected into multiple active discovery lenses without duplicating its evidentiary independence

capabilities: up to two allowlisted ad-hoc discovery questions

verified_live_state.reason: JANUS_DESIRES seed is empty; optional GitHub Copilot synthesis remains quota-limited, so no desire is fabricated

beetle_scheduler.base_fairness: four priority slots plus one least-recently-served direction when possible
beetle_scheduler.mirror_fairness: all four lenses guaranteed each cycle when at least four lane slots exist

first_cross_repo_memory_pass.meaning: Lapis routed an addressed unverified discovery batch; Hrain independently fetched, validated and persisted it without writing discovery content into Hrain main.

all_four_mirror_live_check.important_negative: some specialized repositories had zero currently matching REVERSE contexts; the router preserved the absence instead of fabricating reverse evidence

survives: The four-lens discovery scheduler is operational.
Demiurge priorities are consumed by the Beetle scheduler.
A quota-free explicit JANUS desire control plane exists and is bounded.
An empty desire plane remains empty rather than being inferred.
One source can retain several discovery contexts without being counted as several independent sources.
Cross-repository discovery memory transfer has completed successfully on Hrain.
Target scientific main branches remain separate from Beetle discovery memory.
Fan-out is compacted to bounded rolling snapshots rather than dumping the whole corpus into every repository.
not_established: Every Beetle candidate is scientifically useful.
Demiurge priority is evidence of importance or truth.
JANUS currently has an unconstrained autonomous model desire channel.
The optional model synthesis channel is currently available despite quota exhaustion.
A routed item is verified merely because a target repository stored it.
Any Beetle discovery changes the proof ledger automatically.

seal: THE MIRROR MAY MULTIPLY QUESTIONS; IT MAY NOT MULTIPLY EVIDENCE. THE BEETLE MAY FEED EVERY ORGAN; EACH ORGAN MUST DIGEST AND VERIFY FOR ITSELF.
